metadata.title: BeerTasting 2,469 款公开目录

batches.selection: Purposively selected geographically spread breweries, native list order, per-page IDS exports. First target unique IDs are retained in manifest order; not a global random sample.
batches.source_scope: Public product catalogue only; not all independently verified craft, current availability or production locations.

batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most two ordinary public HTML pages per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

regional_batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most two ordinary public HTML pages per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

Up to first two public 15-item list pages per researched brewery, at most 30 records per brewery. Existing imported UUIDs and explicit cider/mead are excluded. This is a geographic convenience sample, not exhaustive or random.
Geographically selected public brewery listings. Brewery craft certification unknown; industrial_reference entries explicitly qualified. No login/private API or remote image download.

batches.selection: Requested Georgia (country), New Zealand, mainland China, India and multiple African countries. Preserve prior 1432 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.

regional_batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most one ordinary public HTML page per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

First public 15-item list page per researched brewery, at most 15 records per brewery. Existing imported UUIDs and explicit cider/mead are excluded. This is a geographic convenience sample, not exhaustive or random.

batches.selection: New city references across the Americas, Africa, Eurasia and Oceania, prioritizing geographic gaps. Preserve prior 1848 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.

regional_batches.selection: One public first page per new brewery, selected for image/description overlap; all page rows retained. Paper Plane is a China geographic exception with 2 pictured descriptions; missing descriptions are not synthesized.

batches.selection: New city references across the Americas, Africa, Eurasia and Oceania, prioritizing geographic gaps. Preserve prior 2372 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.

metadata.scopeNote: 原始 IDS 1000 条完整保留，另有 1469 条普通公开 HTML 地理扩采；总计 119 家、6 洲。不是全球全量目录，也未认证全部为独立精酿。
metadata.locationNote: 全部为城市或聚落级参考点，不是精确厂址或逐款生产地。
metadata.imageNote: 1711 个非占位候选图片记录；成功缓存后使用本地原图及 WebP 缩略图，失败与未缓存项显示无图，不回退热链。缓存不等于逐张图像身份核验。

license.note: 未取得全库或图片再利用授权；未将其标注为开放许可。

beers.name: Bierol - The Padawan
beers.description: No. First of all. The Padawan is not named after Star Wars. The similarity of names is pure, though by no means undesirable, coincidence. Padawan means "Pale Ale doing alright without a name" and was chosen as the beer name for an unnamed Bierol Pale Ale in an online vote in 2014. Today, The Padawan is not only already a classic but also the No. 1 in the core range. And there is a reason for this: The Padawan is incredibly fruity, incredibly velvety and has everything a Pale Ale needs: The right dose (which is of course not exactly small) of high-quality hops, a fine, almost creamy mouthfeel, a slender amber-colored body and a bit dry in the finish. But above all: mango. In the nose, on the palate, and it lingers. For a long time. Really long. Sparkling, fresh, lean and with a distinct bitterness. By no means just a summer beer. Our favorite beer of all!

beers.description: The Story: Bierol and the Milchbuben have long enjoyed a friendship that goes beyond beer and cheese. Now, however, this has been sealed by a very special collaboration. Awarded 1st place in the Food Innovation Prize of the Province of Tyrol.

beers.name: Bierol - Mountain Pale Ale
beers.description: Hops, malt and yeast come here like an avalanche. Very light at first, but then rapidly increasing. In the nose, hoppy exoticism mixed with malty toffee and a few nuances of the house yeast. A full-bodied, powerful malt body with caramel undertones then pushes onto the tongue. And yet the hops are always present, with a very clear and engaging bitterness at the end.

beers.name: Bierol - El Patrón
beers.description: Who is this El Patrón actually? Not the evil drug lord from Colombia, but the one who is the inspiration for this beer. That will remain a secret forever! But what remains a mystery is the similarity to the character of this Double India Pale Ale. Because what comes through on the nose, tongue and palate is powerful. A strong, full-bodied representative of the style. Incredibly creamy and velvety, actually even somehow gentle. And yet El Patrón quickly shows what it can do. On the nose, it has captivating tropical passion fruit notes, a little honey and vanilla, which soon give way to grassy-green hop aromas in the first sip. A full body that is paired with a strong bitterness at the end. And then there's the alcohol. Yes, you can feel it too. This beer moves through the impressions like a wave. Sometimes quiet, sometimes loud, sometimes soft, sometimes hard. But always powerful. Just like El Patrón.

But what remains a mystery is the similarity to the character of this Double India Pale Ale. Because what comes through on the nose, tongue and palate is powerful. A strong, full-bodied representative of the style. Incredibly creamy and velvety, actually even somehow gentle. And yet El Patrón quickly shows what it can do. On the nose, it has captivating tropical passion fruit notes, a little honey and vanilla, which soon give way to grassy-green hop aromas in the first sip. A full body that is paired with a strong bitterness at the end. And then there's the alcohol. Yes, you can feel it too. This beer moves through the impressions like a wave. Sometimes quiet, sometimes loud, sometimes soft, sometimes hard. But always powerful. Just like El Patrón.

beers.name: Bierol - Hammer Time (Hoppebräu x Bierol)
beers.description: Collaboration with Hoppebräu friendship. For us that means: spending a great time together. Or translated into the best English, a hammer time. Or to quote from MC Hammer's catchy tune while dancing, U can't touch this. We have such a friendship with Hoppebräu from the tranquil Waakirchen in Bavaria. Markus brewed his first brew in Schwoich. We have experienced a lot together. It's always fun and usually associated with little sleep and lots of beer. And then you keep saying. Wasn't it awesome time? The first joint collab was 2015 with a session pale ale, followed by a sour pale ale in 2017. Now it was time again. Not quite as Session Sour like this time. But the result is just as tasty. As befits a gscheids IPA, the hops reach the nose in full bloom, more precisely in the form of apricot, grapefruit and pine. The taste is then further fruity, complemented by herbal notes, straight, rather dry and with a pleasant but present bitterness.

beers.name: Cantillon - Classic Gueuze
beers.description: Cantillon Gueuze is the Belgian beer par excellence - a perfect blend of one, two and three year old lamb. Tart and slightly sour, Cantillon Gueuze is the real champagne among beers. It is fermented only with wild air yeast from the Brussels Senne valley and matured in centuries-old oak barrels. It is also certified organic in Belgium. A true world classic that will inspire true beer connoisseurs. During late winter and early spring, the Cantillon family brewers will match and blend one, two and three year old lambic for a balanced texture and flavor. In general, the younger lambic is thinner, livelier, and milder on the palate; the older lambic is harder, more complex and penetratingly sour. However, the beer in each barrel is unique, and one three year old lambic can be radically different in taste from another. There is no formula for mixing and no expectation of year-to-year consistency. Brewmaster Jean-Pierre Van Roy simply says that he hopes for the same "harmony" every time. The artfully blended lambic is immediately bottled, and another miraculous event occurs: the mixture of lambic from several different barrels triggers a second fermentation in the bottle. This is the essence of the méthode champenoise from which champagne is made. The end product is called "Gueuze". A few months in the bottle "condition" the beer - it forms carbonic acid, concentrates and organizes the aromas. Under the right storage conditions, fermentation in the bottle will last for years. beers.name: Basqueland - Pink Flamingo
beers.description: Think pink! We just brewed a second batch of this sour that you’ve liked so much. This time we’ve adjusted the alcohol to 5.2% to make it even more drinkable and almost perfect for summer time. Flamingos are a stunning pink color as a result of their diet. We want to make you glow like a flamingo. So we’ve made a refreshing beer with added raspberries, hibiscus, and passionfruit (not pink but delicious) to give this beer and you a beautiful pink hue. The tannins released by the fruit flesh add a subtle bitterness that complements the fruity sourness of this rosé beer.
beers.originalDescription:
Think pink! We just brewed a second batch of this sour that you’ve liked so much. This time we’ve adjusted the alcohol to 5.2% to make it even more drinkable and almost perfect for summer time.

Flamingos are a stunning pink color as a result of their diet. We want to make you glow like a flamingo. So we’ve made a refreshing beer with added raspberries, hibiscus, and passionfruit (not pink but delicious) to give this beer and you a beautiful pink hue. The tannins released by the fruit flesh add a subtle bitterness that complements the fruity sourness of this rosé beer.

beers.name: Basqueland - Lau Teilatu
beers.description: Step into the world of “Lau Teilatu”. This Quadruple IPA showcases the Mosaic hop and reaches an impressive 11% ABV, with a full ton of malts added, we pushed the mash tun to its limits. Just like the moon in the iconic song, this beer takes you on a captivating journey. With complex aromas of stone fruit, tropical notes, and berry-like character, it’s the hoppiest Basqueland beer ever, with a mindblowing dry-hop of 34g/L of Mosaic. Savor it slowly, and let Lau Teilatu light up your taste buds.

We find it to be supremely soft in the midst of an onslaught of flavor...a beer we are quite proud of.

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - King JJJuliusss
beers.description: I brewed an American Pale Ale - Beneficiaries of Chance - in celebration of marrying the love of my life, Lauren (aka Tree House L-Dog). On the eve of our first anniversary, I brewed another beer for Lauren, In Perpetuity. It hopes to celebrate foreverness - in love, passion, and regardless of circumstance - the notion that what is good and beloved will last forever. In Perpetuity is brewed with a simple malt bill and two of my favorite hops - Citra, and Nelson. It pours a hazy bright orange in the glass and mixes notes of tropical fruit with a strong citrus backbone. Soft, and eminently drinkable. I hope you enjoy it.

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - Summer
beers.description: Summer is brewed with the spirit and character of the season in mind. Utilizing a grist of pale malt and significant amounts of flaked oats paired with sunny American hops including Magnum, Citra, and Amarillo, Summer pours a glowing yellow color in the glass & emits notes of orange juice, mango gummies, clementine sorbet, and citrus pith. The flavor follows suit, making this beer the perfect accompaniment to a day by the pool or at the beach this summer!

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - Emperor Julius
beers.description: Emperor Julius stands tall alongside Very HHHazyyy at the very top of the Tree House family tree. We don't take brewing a beer like this lightly. It has to make sense, and the flavors have to be soft, rounded, elegant, and easy to drink all the way through the glass. To that end, we consider Emperor Julius to be a triumph. It pours an opaque orange in the glass and gives off notes of orange juice, orange Starburst, and overripe mango. It's the summation of almost 15 years of refinement of our unique style of hoppy beer!

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - JJJuiceee Project
beers.description: Deviating from our customary process, we utilized a small amount of hop extract in the kettle and saved the entirety of the hhhoppp onslaught for the cold side of the brewing process. We carefully adjusted the base beer, crafting it to carry a much bigger body and denser mouthfeel than Juice Project resulting in a deft balance of flavors. We taste the juice of freshly harvested oranges, mango marmalade, tropical fruit punch, and overripe pineapple. It is pure bliss! Enjoy!

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - Wanderer
beers.description: Wanderer is our unfiltered German-style Helles Lager. A meticulous, highly technical beer brewed utilizing traditional techniques and ingredients, Wanderer is crisp, bright, and immensely enjoyable. Wanderer pours a brilliant straw gold color in the glass with a puffy, bright white foam. It carries a flavor profile of doughy malts, light straw, clean lager yeast, and just the right dash of zippy noble hops. Beers that command your attention are a wonderful thing. Beers that can fade into the background and sort of be an unspoken companion to celebratory moments in life are also a wonderful thing and deserve to be held in equally high esteem. As a crisp, highly drinkable, and beautifully executed beer, Wanderer fits this profile beautifully.

beers.name: Tree House Brewing Co. - Almighty Julius
beers.description: Julius, a trend-breaking IPA and flagship in our line-up, is a beer we hold in deep reverie, a paragon we approach with awe and respect with each passing turn on the brewhouse. Without Julius there is no Tree House, and without Tree House there is no Julius. We are deeply grateful to it for bestowing upon us the cherished opportunity to pursue creative endeavors beyond our wildest dreams So, with the utmost care, behold Almighty Julius, a Triple IPA rendition of our benchmark! The Almighty is crafted with paramount attention to detail and admiration for what came before it. It builds upon our past by encompassing years of toil, representing the legacy we wish to leave behind and the magic we aspire to continue as long as we are able. Most importantly, we craft it to live up to the goodwill you have granted us since our earliest days. The Julius family is a cornerstone to our endeavors at Tree House, endeavors that have seen us through hardship, friendship, life, and business in ways we could not have imagined starting out. We can't fathom a better way to celebrate eleven fortunate years than with this progressive beer representing the Tree House spirit at its core. We hope you enjoy it in good health and good spirits, and we thank you for your fervent support of our brewery.

beers.description: The Hitachino Nest Espresso Stout is deep black and has a slightly oily consistency. The foam of this Japanese stout is a hit and a dream for any stout lover. With large volume, a fine-pored consistency and a dreamlike brownish color he beautifies the sight of the beer. A scent as you would expect, intense coffee, espresso, mocha and cocoa flavors enchant the nose. In the background subtle smoke nuances come into play. In the Antrunk spreads a fine bitterness of roasted aromas and reminiscent of dark chocolate. A strong flavor of cocoa enchants from the middle and lets the intense flavor of espresso, coffee and mocha go first. At the finish, the espresso notes increase even more and the bitterness becomes a bit more succinct. A taste that has something of a cold espresso. The intense aromas are literally sticking to your tongue and letting this wonderful stout linger in your mouth for a long time. The Hitachino Nest Espresso Stout is a must-have for any Stout lover.

beers.name: Kiuchi Brewery - Hitachino Nest Anbai Ale
beers.description: Anbai literally means "salty plum" and the word is also used to describe the status of taste and aroma. Ii Anbai means "just right"! Hitachino Nest Anbai Ale is brewed based on the alcohol-rich version (7%) of the Siganture beer Hitachino Nest White Ale, topped with locally grown green plum (ume) and topped with a pinch of Japanese sea salt (moshio). The balance between acidity and bitterness comes from the plum and the subtle salinity. The great umami taste of sea salt is "Ii Anbai - just right!".

beers.originalDescription:

From us to you with enjoyment.

beers.name: LERVIG - 3 Bean Stout Rum Barrel Aged 2018
beers.description: This Imperial Stout was created in collaboration with the Brazilian brewery Way Beer. The addition of vanilla, tonka and cocoa beans gives this deep black beer its intense taste. In the smell, notes of coffee, liquorice and chocolate can be discerned, while the initial taste convinces with a chocolatey and roasted taste. The beer is best enjoyed at 10-13 ° C and goes very well with sweet dishes.

beers.name: Einstök - Arctic Berry Ale
beers.description: SUMARDAGURINN FYRSTI means the beginning of summer and the arrival of warmer temperatures. At Einstök we celebrate these months of uninterrupted daylight with our refreshing, seasonally limited wheat beer. Refined with delicious Icelandic blueberries hand-picked near the Arctic Circle, Berjabúið Vellir in Dalvík is the perfect beer for your summer adventures. Enjoy it while you can - it will go away with the midnight sun.

beers.description: Meet ‘SUMMERLAY - FIN FIN IPA’, this IPA encapsulates the essence of a modern IPA. From the modern new world hops such as BRU-1, El Dorado, Citra, and other stars to showcase the island pineapple, fresh tropical fruit, citrus, and a dank punch; balancing robust flavors with a refreshing and crushable quality. Inspired by the Thai term 'Fin Fin,' a tribute to life's most exquisite moments, Fin Fin IPA encourages savoring every sip. Whether unwinding by the shore or enjoying lively conversations with friends, this brew promises endless delight, evoking a vibrant tropical paradise with each taste. It’s a totally beach life IPA.

beers.name: Renaissance Brewing Limited - Tribute
beers.description: Tribute is a new beer made in an old style. The Barley Wines of the old days back to the days of yore when a special 'heavy' ale was needed. Tribute is brewed by hand using Elizabethan 'Doubleword Mashing' process that yields very high gravity word. In this process the mashing and sparging process yields a normal beer is repeated a second time. The second mash and sparge is done using the word collected from the first mash instead of water. This concentrated word is said to have a long time to come. The result is a mellow, warming ale with layers of biscuit, roasted hazelnut and maple syrup, with hints of black current and toast.

beers.name: Toit Brewpub - Tint-In-Wit
beers.description: The Tint-In-Wit is our refreshing, Belgian style fruity ale and our most popular beer. It is made from Pilsner malt and locally sourced unmalted Indian wheat. A classic Belgian Wit with a tint in it. This beer is also infused with local coriander and fresh orange peel, giving it a spicy-sweet, citrusy taste, making it not only refreshing but also a very easy and sessionable beer
beers.originalDescription:

beers.name: Tale African - Cocoa Stout (8)
beers.description: Stout beers are a variety of Porter, which were first brewed in London around 1730. Porter beers were always dark and the name refers to its popularity with street and river porters. It quickly became popular with the working classes. Porter was the first beer style that conquered the world by the end of the 18th century. Somewhere along the line, porter drinkers added the adjective ‘stout’ to Porter when ordering, referring to the strong Porter beer. Eventually, the name Stout became slang for strong dark beer. The Tale version of this historical beer is extraordinary, as it is the strongest found in the region and the only one in Africa using Ghana cocoa in the brewing process. Adding in rice alongside with roasted barley and malt, this top fermented Cocoa Stout is much more drinkable than typical bitter stouts. Tale 8 or Black Tale has a surprising aroma and invites you to discover its delicate chocolate and coffee notes followed by a touch of sweet bitterness.

beers.name: Fulton Beer - SWEET CHILD OF VINE
beers.description: Generous quantities of Simcoe and Glacier hops are added throughout the boil. Then, late in fermentation, we infuse the Sweet Child with another dose of Glaciers, imparting a bouquet of hop aroma that veritably bursts forth upon serving. The Sweet Child has a serious malt backbone to stand up to all those hops, creating a delightful balance.

beers.name: Cervejaria Backer - Capitão Senra
beers.description: Captain Senra was filled with 80 years of history. A tribute to the captain and scout of the army of the time of President Juscelino Kubistchek with more than 50 years of passion for Harley Davidson motorcycles. A recipe that balances passion and history with Munich, Vienna and noble hops in an amber beer with a mild flavor and moderate bitterness. Cheers, Captain!

beers.name: Moody Tongue - Orange Blossom Belgian Blonde
beers.description: We always search for exceptional pairings with each of our beers. The Orange Blossom Belgian Blonde is a light-to-medium bodied Belgian-Style Blonde Ale which showcases notes of apricot, orange rock candy and honeysuckle. We love seafood, and our team has found that this beer pairs perfectly with a number of preparations of fish dishes. You'll find this Blonde Ale paired in The Dining Room with our seared black cod, in The Bar with our fried whole black bass, and at Moody Tongue Sushi with our madai nigiri with orange zest and sea salt.

beers.name: Wylam Brewery - Reflections in the Present
beers.description: A compound and fused culture saison brewed in collaboration with the elegant and dandy men of FOREST & MAIN. Starting with an undecorated grist of extra pale base malt, oats and wheat flakes producing an uncomplicated structure for a complex build. A free rise fermentation using a classic farmhouse saison strain is then blended with 3 separate wild barrel fruit cultures. A 5 month fermentation / maturation period leaves us with a spritzed up funky midsummer smasher. Blooming with crisp, clean cider barrel esters followed by a compounded admixture of acidic fresh orchard fruits. Crab apple, white grape, peach flesh and tart lime zest intermingle with aseptic farmyard tannins resulting in a crisp and bracing sunshine quencher.

beers.name: Galway Bay Brewery - Afterglow
beers.description: Our newest core range IPA is here! We’ve had some amazing feedback to our last few hazy IPA’s and we realised it’s long overdue that we add one to our permanent range of beers. Utilising what we learned over the past few years we’ve brewed what we feel is the ideal fridge filling hazy IPA. Packed full of some of our favourite new wave hops and fermented with a fruity aroma packed yeast strain. Idaho 7 and Nelson sauvin from New Zealand deliver big tropical, grapefruit flavours while an addition of strata hops finishes off the flavour profile with a little hop dankness. Built on a base of oats and pale malts for a fluffy fruity finish. Grab one, watch the sunset and enjoy a modern full flavoured IPA

beers.description: The winner of the red beer competition, La Rousse is the result of a mix of 3 malt hops and spices, but the composition is kept top secret. An "iron fist in velvet gloves" as the brewery Mont-Blanc says.

beers.name: Birra Baladin - Rock' n' Roll
beers.description: Hops-heavy, grassy and fruity fragrance, slightly peppery background. Citrus aromas, mango, lychee and raw hops. Style-typical taste, grassiness also appears in the mouth, fruit aroma is well noticeable, but not excessive. Supple body, hides a little about the alcohol content. Mild, fruity bitterness increases in the finish. All components in a very good balance. Pairings: Tasty and grilled meats, cold cuts, burgers and middle-aged cheese.

beers.name: Birra Baladin - Isaac
beers.description: Emphasizes the fruity aroma, hidden malt aromas such as baguette crumb. Lovely, refreshing citrus-accentuated bouquet. Scent of orange, linden blossom, coriander seeds. Light initial taste, fruit aromas develop quickly in the mouth. Mild review suits the light body very much. In the end, a flowery aroma remains, which is detached from the spice component. Pairings: tender cooked fish (lightly seasoned), white meat, soft cheese, mozzarella.

beers.name: Birra Baladin - Wayan
beers.description: Grainy and peppery aroma, accompanied by tea (bergamot). Flowery scent, accompanied by honey and a little caramel, always perceptible peppery spice component. Medium-heavy body, mild recency, good development of the aroma. Finale is introduced by floral aromas, which are replaced by the pepper, which remains in the mouth for longer. Remarkable interplay of flavors. Pairings: oysters, shellfish, shrimp or raw fish, grilled white meat, middle-aged cow's milk cheese. Ingredients: water, barley malt, spelled, wheat malt, wheat, rye, buckwheat, hops, spice mixture, citrus peel and aromatic herbs, sugar, yeast.

beers.description: Scent malty, chocolaty, bread-like. Memory of dried fruits and some winter spices. Slightly oily taste, heavy body, malty dominant, plum and raisin. Fine-pearling carbon dioxide is released in the initial taste, the beer appears almost still in the finish. Finally, the roasted aromas emerge and intensify, slightly warming sensation on the palate. Pairings: Tasty meat dishes such as stews, cream soups, vegetable stews, blue cheese, chocolate desserts or cakes

beers.name: Labietis - Labietis Sencitis
beers.description: A Nordic-style pilsner brewed from Latvian barley and Czech hops. The airy, grassy aroma of Žatec hops introduces a delightfully bare flavor presentation, which continues with youthful lightness, the barely concealed bitterness of freshly mown hay with echoes of pale barley malt. Crisp, playful and carefree.

beers.name: Ground Zero - Amber Guerre
beers.description: There is only one right way to ask for this beer. First, start growing a mustache. Second, practice on your French accent. Then, when you are finally confident that you can pass for a French tourist in Oklahoma, put on your turtle neck, go to the bar and say to the bartender: "I WOULD LIKE TO BUY AN AMBERGUERRE". You will be rewarded with a beer bursting of floral hops in the aroma, with a complex taste where amber malt plays the leading role, followed by a bitter hoppy aftertaste. Pour les connaiseurs.

beers.name: Ground Zero - Deranj Blondă
beers.description: Kölsch is a traditional German style of beer that originated in the Cologne area. However, being a product with a protected geographical indication, in order to be able to bear the name Kölsch, the beer must be produced within a radius of 50 KM around Cologne. That's why we simply call her "Blonde." For this beer we use malt brought from N-V Germany and yeast right from a small factory in Cologne. The beer you hold in your hand is fermented and matured naturally until it reaches the specific, light and refreshing taste.

beers.name: Ground Zero - XperimentALE #010 - Unfiltered Pils
beers.description: This time we brewed ...... a PILS! Ya', ya', for real! It is not a Pale Ale beer but an unfiltered pils inspired by the most famous beer of this style in the world. Our new beer, which belongs to a style that was born in the heart of Europe and conquered the hole planet, deserves a proper name - AVIATOR! This is our new XperimentALE #010, a fresh beer with subtle and malty sweetness that continues with a moderate bitterness with spicy and floral notes, characteristic to the type of hops we used. The color is pale gold, with a hazy tint at low temperature.

beers.name: Big Shed - F Yeah
beers.description: F-yeah pays homage to the basic standard of craft beer, American pale ale. A base of light malt forms the basis and supports the aroma and biscuit malt, which gives the beer its backbone. The hops are added at the beginning of the boil and at the end and provide the citrus aroma that balances out a firm bitterness. A full beer that can be enjoyed at any time.

beers.name: Waldschlösschen - Sommerbier 2025
beers.description: Use of Pale Ale malt and three hop varieties (Cascade, Hallertau Tradition, Callista), as well as Nottingham Ale yeast. Pale ale is one of the oldest light beer styles in the world - originally brewed in England at the beginning of the 18th century, this top-fermented specialty has continued to evolve. The variety is characterized by a balanced hop bitterness/aroma mixture. For this year's Saxon interpretation, we use the hop varieties Mosaic and Smaragd - a refreshing beer suitable for summer! Original wort: 11.7°
beers.originalDescription:
Use of Pale Ale malt and three hop varieties (Cascade, Hallertau Tradition, Callista), as well as Nottingham Ale yeast.
Pale ale is one of the oldest light beer styles in the world - originally brewed in England at the beginning of the 18th century, this top-fermented specialty has continued to evolve. The variety is characterized by a balanced hop bitterness/aroma mixture.
For this year's Saxon interpretation, we use the hop varieties Mosaic and Smaragd
- a refreshing beer suitable for summer! Original wort: 11.7°

beers.description: A special beer that was brewed together with the people of Dnipro. This is a recipe from our brewers of their vision of the spirit of Dnipro. While developing it, they were inspired by their hometown, guests and their stories, impressions and ideas about the perfect taste of beer. Our brewers have filtered all this through the prism of their vision, experience and skill. This is a crisp, refreshing light beer with a distinct malt and hop flavour that will turn your receptors as fast as the waves of the Dnipro ❤️

beers.name: Mova Brewing - Anti Imperial Stout
beers.description: Strong, like Ukrainian courage, the Anti-Imperial Stout boasts a rich and intense flavor. In the aroma, one can detect liqueur-like coffee motifs. The taste is well-balanced, coffee-forward, with notes of dark chocolate. Despite its high strength, the beer is pleasantly drinkable, gently warming from within.

beers.name: Mova Brewing - Ukrainian Golden Ale
beers.description: A bright, strong beer with a balanced malt character, floral-citrus flavor, and grapefruit notes. A touch of caramel sweetness and Ukrainian coriander add depth and spiciness. Moderate bitterness makes the beer exceptionally drinkable. Dry hopping with Motueka and Aurora enhances its vibrant hoppy profile, making it refreshing and modern.

beers.name: Engkanto - Lager
beers.description: Lager is the most popular and consumed style of beer in the world. Their flagship lager offers a crisp, clean drinking experience. With the freshest Amarillo and El Dorado hops on to balance out the refreshing all-grain malt bill, this combination is truly a craft. Designed to remind the Filipino drinker of the beer they grew up drinking, the Engkanto lager is as refreshing as it is flavorful, making it appropriate for any type of occasion in any climate. What makes this beer exciting is that it blends a traditional style with new world hops to blast the palate with citrus aroma and flavor, reminiscent of tropical fruit and lime zest.

beers.name: Engkanto - Green Lava
beers.description: The Double India Pale Ale or DIPA was born out of the modern American concept that "bigger is better". While sometimes true, the most important tenant when it comes to beer is always balance. It is paramount to remember all ingredients are never equal and going big on hops is not the same as going big on grain. Therefore, the intent of this incredible beer was to create a beer that was big in alcohol and flavor but still remarkably drinkable in a tropical climate. Everything about this beer is BIG! From its soft mouthfeel to its exploding hop flavor, this beer excites the senses. Although this beer is over 8% ABV, the intense blend of citrus and passionfruit flavor profiles makes this beer dangerously drinkable.

beers.name: Engkanto - Blonde Ale
beers.description: In the beer world, the "ale" is the younger cousin of the older, more grown-up "lager". When conceptualizing this particular beer, the goal was to create a similar drinking experience to that of their flagship lager. While it looks and feels like the lager, the flavor is as unique as possible. Their spin on a traditional golden ale, the blonde ale is a very light, refreshingly crisp beer. Made with a very simple malt bill to accentuate a much more complex flavor profile. Their blonde ale is bursting with citrus notes, from the generous amounts of Cascade, Amarillo, and Citra hops used throughout the process.

beers.name: Engkanto IPA
beers.description: The India Pale Ale gets its name from the beer that the English shipped to India in the 17th century when drinking water was risky at best. For the long journey across multiple oceans, the English would throw large amounts of hops into the barrels of beer to prevent spoilage, because hops are a natural anti-septic. Flash forward 400 years and that necessary process is now one of the most popular beer "styles" in the world. As a tribute to the original English and modern American IPA styles, their IPA is a combination of smooth body and robust flavor profile. Darker in color, this India Pale Ale malt bill offers a very interesting mouthfeel balance. A specific blend of Centennial, Cascade, Columbus, Simcoe, and Amarillo hops present an incredible aroma followed by intense piney and citrus flavor.

beers.name: Engkanto Pale Ale
beers.description: The stylistic origins of the Pale Ale can be found in 18th century Europe, with what is now more commonly referred to as a "bitter". Engkanto decided that it was time to flip that expected traditional style, and their efforts gave birth to the Engkanto Pale Ale. The only way to articulate this drinking experience is flavor. Their Pale Ale presents a very "sessionable" drinking experience, beginning with a strong citrus aroma, followed by a soft, yet complex malt bill, and ending with an exceptionally balanced hop flavor. The overall character of the beer is highlighted by candy-like citrus and passionfruit flavor that is remarkably refreshing.

beers.name: Baird Beer - Wabi-Sabi
beers.description: Can there ever be enough permutations of the great India Pale Ale style? Of course not. In this beautifully nuanced, Japanese esthetic-influenced ale, we marry in the conditioning tank ample dosages of earthy-herbal dry hops (Hersbrucker, Styrian Golding, Santiam) with deft additions of whole leaf Shizuoka green tea. The result of this international botanical marriage is, in a word, sublime. Baird Beer, as you know, is unfiltered and the addition of whole leaf green tea to Wabi-Sabi IPA has contributed a very strong particle sediment. Do not fear or fret, this is all-natural good stuff and it tastes great! You will not find this in a can or mug of your favorite industrial brew.

beers.name: Gorilla Baby Sour
beers.description: "Baby Sour" A traditional berliner weisse. A low calorie beer, sour and refreshing, with a hit of roasted coffee. Werk Coffee Roaster's signature blend "Baby" was used to maximise the coffee character with the sourness. The brewing process of kettle souring added its individuality to the acidity and the deep sweetness of Werk's signature coffee blend, "Baby", and the single origin beans (Colombia El Paraiso Lychee, India Attikan Kent Natural, Costa Rica Santa Teresa). Enjoy the subtle aroma of freshly roasted coffee, followed by a sourness that hightens your taste buds, and finishing with a smooth coffee mouthfeel.

beers.name: Minoh Beer - Minoh Beer X Ichiro‘sMalt Barrel aged Imperial Stout
beers.description: Barrel aged for 10 months in precious "Ichiro's Malt" whiskey barrels. This is a barrel-aged beer that has been slowly and slowly aged at low temperatures. Over time, the barrel aroma and flavors derived from the original species are transferred to the beer, creating a complex interplay of various elements that transcend the boundaries of beer. The chocolate and coffee-like aromas of the roasted malts and the smoky, vanilla-like flavors from the oak barrels are complex and unique. Enjoy this mellow and deep beer that time has woven together.

beers.name: Tamamura Honten Co. - Shiga Kogen Indian Summer Saison
beers.description: We brewed this favorite saison with plenty of hops to make it last through the summer and into the "Indian Summer" season of late fall. Saison was originally brewed during the off-season from winter to spring for summer farming. The hops were used to improve preservation, making this style of beer stand out among Belgian beers. The IBU is a little lower than a regular IPA, around 50, but the dry body and balance make it moderately (!?) bitter. It is bitter. The Saison yeast gives it a dryness that makes you not feel the alcohol content, and a fruity character that is not unpleasant. The hops are mainly new varieties from New Zealand and the US. It has a refreshing aroma reminiscent of blue citrus fruits. Alcohol percentage : 7.0%. Beer Style : Belgian IPA
